title: Sampaati details Angada about Seetha
introduction: Sampaati details his narration telling monkeys as to how he knew the abduction of Seetha. He says that his son Supaarshva is the eyewitness in her abduction and narrates that account to monkeys, which his son narrated to him.

A word about this and next four chapters. These chapters from 59 to 63 do not find place in various other mms, besides having some contradictory statements in their verses. Hence, these are said to be interpolated chapters. However, if it is questioned as to why they are still being incorporated in translations, in spite of the irregularities noticed, for this the reply is 'because most ancient commentators have given elaborate commentaries on them they are stetted...' and thus these chapters are held valid.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे एको न षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 59th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तत् अमृत आस्वादम् गृध्र राजेन भाषितम् |
निशम्य मुदितो हृष्टाः ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tat amṛta āsvādam gṛdhra rājena bhāṣitam |
niśamya mudito hṛṣṭāḥ te vacaḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of that kingly eagle Sampaati that are relishable like ambrosia, then those best fly-jumpers are gladdened and rejoiced.

verses.devanagari:
जांबवान् वानर श्रेष्ठः सह सर्वैः प्लवंगमैः |
भू तलात् सहसा उत्थाय गृध्र राजानम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
jāmbavān vānara śreṣṭhaḥ saha sarvaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ |
bhū talāt sahasā utthāya gṛdhra rājānam abravīt
verses.translation: Then the best fly-jumper Jambavanta got up along with all of the fly-jumpers from the surface of earth on which they sat for self-immolation, and spoke to kingly eagle Sampaati.

verses.devanagari:
क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम् |
तत् आख्यातु भवान् सर्वम् गतिः भव वन ओकसाम्
verses.iast:
kva sītā kena vā dṛṣṭā ko vā harati maithilīm |
tat ākhyātu bhavān sarvam gatiḥ bhava vana okasām
verses.translation: "You please tell vividly as to where is Seetha, who has actually seen her, who has abducted Maithili, and thus you help all these forest-dwellers.

glosses.meaning: by whom, or, she is [actually] seen
Maithili is, abducts, or, who - who abducted her
recourse, you become you help them out.

verses.devanagari:
को दाशरथि बाणानाम् वज्र वेग निपातिनाम् |
स्वयम् लक्ष्मणम् मुक्तानाम् न चिंतयति विक्रमम्
verses.iast:
ko dāśarathi bāṇānām vajra vega nipātinām |
svayam lakṣmaṇam muktānām na ciṃtayati vikramam
verses.translation: "Who is inadvertent of the onslaught of Rama's arrows, or of those that are personally bolted by Lakshmana, which arrows will be falling with the speed of thunderbolts?" Thus, Jambavanta and others asked Sampaati.

glosses.meaning: thunderbolt, as with the speed of, falling

verses.devanagari:
स हरीन् प्रति संयुक्तान् सीता श्रुति समाहितान् |
पुनः आश्वासयन् प्रीत इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa harīn prati saṃyuktān sītā śruti samāhitān |
punaḥ āśvāsayan prīta idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Sampaati is gladdened at the monkeys who refrained from self-immolation, and he gladly said this sentence to them so as to cheer them up who are now contemplating to listen about Seetha.

glosses.meaning: to them who refrained from self-immolation

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयताम् इह वैदेह्या यथा मे हरणम् श्रुतम् |
येन च अपि मम आख्यातम् यत्र च आयत लोचना
verses.iast:
śrūyatām iha vaidehyā yathā me haraṇam śrutam |
yena ca api mama ākhyātam yatra ca āyata locanā
verses.translation: "I will now narrate as to how I have listened about the abduction of Vaidehi, by whom it is said to me, and where that wide-eyed Seetha is...

glosses.meaning: by me, as to how, listened
wide, eyed Seetha, where she is, also

verses.devanagari:
अहम् अस्मिन् गिरौ दुर्गे बहु योजनम् आयते |
चिरात् निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीण प्राण पराक्रमः
verses.iast:
aham asmin girau durge bahu yojanam āyate |
cirāt nipatito vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇa prāṇa parākramaḥ
verses.translation: "At one time I fell down on this impassable mountain which is breadth-wise in many yojana-s, whereupon my age has advanced and my liveliness and forcefulness have slackened...

verses.devanagari:
तम् माम् एवम् गतम् पुत्रः सुपार्श्वो नाम नामतः |
आहारेण यथा कालम् बिभर्ति पतताम् वरः
verses.iast:
tam mām evam gatam putraḥ supārśvo nāma nāmataḥ |
āhāreṇa yathā kālam bibharti patatām varaḥ
verses.translation: "My son who is the best one among all birds, and who is named as Supaarshva by his name is sustaining me who am deteriorated to dire straits, with timely sustenance...

glosses.meaning: among all birds, the best one

verses.devanagari:
तीक्ष्ण कामाः तु गंधर्वाः तीक्ष्ण कोपा भुजंगमाः |
मृगाणाम् तु भयम् तीक्ष्णम् ततः तीक्ष्ण क्षुधा वयम्
verses.iast:
tīkṣṇa kāmāḥ tu gaṃdharvāḥ tīkṣṇa kopā bhujaṅgamāḥ |
mṛgāṇām tu bhayam tīkṣṇam tataḥ tīkṣṇa kṣudhā vayam
verses.translation: "Passion is exigent to the celestial-artists gandharva-s, aggression is exigent to snakes, fear is exigent to deer, like that hunger is exigent to us, the eagles...

verses.devanagari:
स कदाचित् क्षुधा आर्तस्य मम आहार कान्क्षिणः |
गत सूर्यो अहनि प्राप्तो मम पुत्रो हि अनामिषः
verses.iast:
sa kadācit kṣudhā ārtasya mama āhāra kānkṣiṇaḥ |
gata sūryo ahani prāpto mama putro hi anāmiṣaḥ
verses.translation: "On some day when hunger was aching me and I was aching for food, my son Supaarshva turned up without flesh when the sun of the day went down...

glosses.meaning: in day, went away, sun - till sun is down on that day

verses.devanagari:
स मया आहार संरोधात् पीडितः प्रीति वर्धनः |
अनुमान्य यथा तत्त्वम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa mayā āhāra saṃrodhāt pīḍitaḥ prīti vardhanaḥ |
anumānya yathā tattvam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: "I reproved him as I was deprived of food, and my son who is an enhancer of my gladness pacified me and said this sentence about what has actually happened ...

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तात यथा कालम् आमिष अर्थी खम् आप्लुतः |
महेन्द्रस्य गिरेः द्वारम् आवृत्य च सुसमाश्रितः
verses.iast:
aham tāta yathā kālam āmiṣa arthī kham āplutaḥ |
mahendrasya gireḥ dvāram āvṛtya ca susamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, father, I as a desirer of flesh flew up to skies in time and overspreading the Mt. Mahendra, I very well hovered on it...

verses.devanagari:
तत्र सत्त्व सहस्राणाम् सागर अन्तर चारिणाम् |
पंथानम् एको अध्यवसम् संनिरोद्धुम् अवाङ् मुखः
verses.iast:
tatra sattva sahasrāṇām sāgara antara cāriṇām |
paṃthānam eko adhyavasam saṃniroddhum avāñ mukhaḥ
verses.translation: " 'I have been hovering there looking downward to completely impede the pathway of thousands of underwater beings of the ocean on my own...

verses.devanagari:
तत्र कश्चित् मया दृष्टः सूर्य उदय सम प्रभाम् |
स्त्रियम् आदाय गच्छन् वै भिन्न अंजन चय उपमः
verses.iast:
tatra kaścit mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūrya udaya sama prabhām |
striyam ādāya gacchan vai bhinna aṃjana caya upamaḥ
verses.translation: " 'There I have seen someone who in simile is like a shoved heap of mascara and he is going away captivating a lady who equals the aurora in her shine.

glosses.meaning: = sun, dawn - aurora, equal, in shine

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् अभ्यवहार अर्थम् तौ दृष्ट्वा कृत निश्चयः |
तेन साम्ना विनीतेन पन्थानम् अनुयाचितः
verses.iast:
so aham abhyavahāra artham tau dṛṣṭvā kṛta niścayaḥ |
tena sāmnā vinītena panthānam anuyācitaḥ
verses.translation: " 'On seeing two of them I resolved to use them up for the purpose of food, but he benignly, basely and beggarly besought way-leave for their traversal...

glosses.meaning: making, resolution - decided to us them up

verses.devanagari:
न हि साम उपपन्नानाम् प्रहर्ता विद्यते भुवि |
नीचेषु अपि जनः कश्चित् किम् अङ्ग बत मत् विधः
verses.iast:
na hi sāma upapannānām prahartā vidyate bhuvi |
nīceṣu api janaḥ kaścit kim añga bata mat vidhaḥ
verses.translation: " 'There will be none assaulting those that entreat in a beggarly manner, even someone among basely people, isn't it! Then what else is to be said of my kind, aha!

glosses.meaning: one who amiably, derives - one who is entreating beggarly
will not be, evident, isn't it

verses.devanagari:
स यातः तेजसा व्योम संक्षिपन् इव वेगतः |
अथ अहम् खे चरैः भूतैः अभिगम्य सभाजितः
verses.iast:
sa yātaḥ tejasā vyoma saṅkṣipan iva vegataḥ |
atha aham khe caraiḥ bhūtaiḥ abhigamya sabhājitaḥ
verses.translation: " 'He hastily went away as though enshrouding the skies with his vigour, and then the beings that move in the firmament have approached and applauded me...

glosses.meaning: by [his] vigour, sky, enshrouding, as though

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या जीवति सीत इति हि अब्रुवन् माम् महर्षयः |
कथंचित् स कलत्रः असौ गतः ते स्वस्ति असंशयम्
verses.iast:
diṣṭyā jīvati sīta iti hi abruvan mām maharṣayaḥ |
kathañcit sa kalatraḥ asau gataḥ te svasti asaṃśayam
verses.translation: " 'The great-sages who approached me in firmament have said to me, 'fortunately Seetha is alive, somehow he that Ravana has gone away with Seetha who in fact is to be protected by one and all like you, anyhow your are blest without a doubt...
notes: Some other mms contain the wording diṣṭyā jīvasi tāta where tāta 'my boy...' is an addressing to the son of Sampaati and then the meaning is: 'my boy, though Seetha is a saveable, defendable person and though you have shown your concern to stall Ravana like your paternal uncle Jataayu... you have not done it and left him off, then unhurt by Ravana you are living, fortunately...'

glosses.meaning: Seetha is, by fortune, living, indeed
along with, one who is to be protected - Seetha
to you, without, doubt, safeness will be there

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः ततो अहम् तैः सिद्धैः परम शोभनैः |
स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसाम् प्रतिवेदितः
पश्यन् दाशरथेः भार्याम् रामस्य जनक आत्मजाम् |
भ्रष्ट आभरण कौशेयाम् शोक वेग पराजिताम्
राम लक्ष्मणयोः नाम क्रोशन्तीम् मुक्त मूर्धजाम् |
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tato aham taiḥ siddhaiḥ parama śobhanaiḥ |
sa ca me rāvaṇo rājā rakṣasām prativeditaḥ
paśyan dāśaratheḥ bhāryām rāmasya janaka ātmajām |
bhraṣṭa ābharaṇa kauśeyām śoka vega parājitām
rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ nāma krośantīm mukta mūrdhajām |
verses.translation: " 'Then those siddha-s, the celestial sages, have informed me on showing her whose ornaments and ochry-silk-sari are disorderly, and who is vanquished by the speediness of her anguish, and who is yelling both the names of Rama and Lakshmana, as the wife of Dasharatha's Rama, the daughter of Janaka. They have also informed on showing him who is abducting her as Ravana, the king of demons.

glosses.meaning: on their seeing - and on showing to me
towards [to me,] I was informed [by siddha-s.]

verses.devanagari:
एष काल अत्ययः तात इति वाक्यविदाम् वरः
एतत् अर्थम् समग्रम् मे सुपार्श्वः प्रत्यवेदयत् |
verses.iast:
eṣa kāla atyayaḥ tāta iti vākyavidām varaḥ
etat artham samagram me supārśvaḥ pratyavedayat |
verses.translation: " 'And hence, oh, father, the lapse of time in my returning home...' thus that best sentence maker Supaarshva informed me all the drift in its entirety..." Thus Sampaati is continuing his narration to monkeys.

glosses.meaning: time, lapse of - in my coming home

verses.devanagari:
तत् श्रुत्वा अपि हि मे बुद्धिः न आसीत् काचित् पराक्रमे
अपक्षो हि कथम् पक्षी कर्म किंचित् समारभेत् |
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā api hi me buddhiḥ na āsīt kācit parākrame
apakṣo hi katham pakṣī karma kiñcit samārabhet |
verses.translation: "Even on listening that it has not come to my mind to dare Ravana. How a wingless bird can initiate any action, indeed!

glosses.meaning: mind, not, is there - no thought occurred to me

verses.devanagari:
यत् तु शक्यम् मया कर्तुम् वाक् बुद्धि गुण वर्तिना
श्रूयताम् तत्र वक्ष्यामि भवताम् पौरुष आश्रयम् |
verses.iast:
yat tu śakyam mayā kartum vāk buddhi guṇa vartinā
śrūyatām tatra vakṣyāmi bhavatām pauruṣa āśrayam |
verses.translation: "But that which is possible for me to do is advising as a votary with the qualities of thinking and advising. Let it be heard as I narrate and in that matter of translating my information into action it certainly depends on your bravery.

glosses.meaning: talking [advising,] thinking, qualities, a votary of
what, but, to do, possible to

verses.devanagari:
वाक् मतिभ्याम् हि सार्वेषाम् करिष्यामि प्रियम् हि वः
यत् हि दाशरथेः कार्यम् मम तत् न अत्र संशयः |
verses.iast:
vāk matibhyām hi sārveṣām kariṣyāmi priyam hi vaḥ
yat hi dāśaratheḥ kāryam mama tat na atra saṃśayaḥ |
verses.translation: "Indeed with my analysis and information to you I wish to make all of you exuberant as I deem that I have done my bit, because whatever task of Rama, the son of Dasharatha, is there that task is mine too. There is no doubt bout it.

glosses.meaning: with words [information,] mind [ analysis,] exuberant, I wish to make [you,] indeed
which is, of Rama of Dasharatha, task

verses.devanagari:
तत् भवन्तो मति श्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः
प्रहिताः कपि राजेन देवैः अपि दुरासदाः |
verses.iast:
tat bhavanto mati śreṣṭhā balavanto manasvinaḥ
prahitāḥ kapi rājena devaiḥ api durāsadāḥ |
verses.translation: "Thereby, I reckon you as the best ones by your aptitude, fortitude and attitude, and as invincible ones even for gods, hence Sugreeva, the king of monkeys, shepherded you...

verses.devanagari:
राम लक्ष्मण बाणाः च निशिताः कंक पत्रिणः
त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् पर्याप्ताः त्राण निग्रहे |
verses.iast:
rāma lakṣmaṇa bāṇāḥ ca niśitāḥ kaṃka patriṇaḥ
trayāṇām api lokānām paryāptāḥ trāṇa nigrahe |
verses.translation: "What is more, the excruciating eagle-feathered arrows of Rama and Lakshmana are enough to give defence or offence to all the three worlds.

glosses.meaning: by Rama's, by Lakshmana's, arrows, what is more

verses.devanagari:
कामम् खलु दशग्रीवः तेजो बल समन्वितः |
भवताम् तु समर्थानाम् न किंचित् अपि दुष्करम्
verses.iast:
kāmam khalu daśagrīvaḥ tejo bala samanvitaḥ |
bhavatām tu samarthānām na kiñcit api duṣkaram
verses.translation: "Perchance that Decahedral demon is definitely a powerful and prideful demon. But, as capable vanara-s there is nothing impossible to you, even in the least.

glosses.meaning: power, pride, possessor of, definitely, perchance

verses.devanagari:
तत् अलम् काल संगेन क्रियताम् बुद्धि निश्चयः |
न हि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवत् विधाः
verses.iast:
tat alam kāla saṃgena kriyatām buddhi niścayaḥ |
na hi karmasu sajjante buddhimanto bhavat vidhāḥ
verses.translation: "Thereby, enough is the time-lapse and make a mental determination. Adventurers and prudent souls of your kind with not backslide in tasks, isn't it!

glosses.meaning: in tasks, will not, backslide, isn't it.
